title.value: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment
title.justification: The title comes directly from the beginning of the provided paper text, which clearly states it as such.
title.quote: The paper to analyze is: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment

extractions.description: This paper explores the use of Transformer architectures in reinforcement learning (RL), focusing on the roles of memory and credit assignment. It provides mathematical definitions for memory and credit assignment lengths and discusses their influence on the performance of Transformers in RL tasks. Through various experiments, the paper reveals that Transformers enhance memory capabilities but not long-term credit assignment, pointing to areas for future research.
